IFA Berlin 2026 Showcases AI Integration in Consumer Tech

The IFA Berlin 2026 consumer electronics trade show featured advancements in artificial intelligence integrated into various gadgets and home technologies. Exhibitors presented ultra-light laptops, AI-powered home appliances, smart beds, connected pet gadgets, and robot dogs. The event highlighted embodied AI, with devices designed to see, move, and interact with the physical world, moving beyond traditional chatbots. Companies like TCL showcased visions of a more connected home through AI and advanced display technologies, with some reports describing the innovations as 'coolest gadgets'.
